mapper.select: SELECT d.defect_code AS "defectCode", t.defect_name AS "defectName", d.equipment_id AS "equipmentId", e.equipment_name AS "equipmentName", sum(d.qty) AS "count" FROM defect_event d JOIN defect_type t ON t.defect_code = d.defect_code JOIN equipment e ON e.equipment_id = d.equipment_id WHERE d.occurred_at >= #{from} AND d.occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY d.defect_code, t.defect_name, t.display_order, d.equipment_id, e.equipment_name ORDER BY sum(d.qty) DESC, t.display_order

WITH counts AS ( SELECT work_order_id, sum(good_qty) FILTER (WHERE equipment_id = (SELECT equipment_id FROM equipment ORDER BY line_order DESC LIMIT 1)) AS finished, sum(bad_qty) AS bad FROM production_event WHERE occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY work_order_id ), top_defect AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.work_order_id) d.work_order_id, t.defect_name FROM defect_event d JOIN defect_type t ON t.defect_code = d.defect_code WHERE d.occurred_at >= #{from} AND d.occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY d.work_order_id, t.defect_name, t.display_order ORDER BY d.work_order_id, sum(d.qty) DESC, t.display_order ) SELECT w.work_order_id AS "workOrderId", w.item_code AS "itemCode", w.status AS "status", COALESCE(c.finished, 0) AS "finishedCount", c.bad AS "badCount", td.defect_name AS "topDefectName" FROM counts c JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id = c.work_order_id LEFT JOIN top_defect td ON td.work_order_id = c.work_order_id ORDER BY w.started_at DESC NULLS LAST, w.work_order_id
